messages.subject: rxImport takes forever
parts:
Hi,
  I am trying to read a 1.5 TB CSV file with 1.6 billion rows and 110 columns using rxImport. I have Revolution R Enterprise Edition (R version 3.1.1) on a server with 64-bit Linux, 132 GB RAM and 32 cores. I initially tried to load the entire file, but since it took too long, now I am trying to load only the first 5 rows with the following function call:

  library(RevoScaleR)
  rxImport(inData = "/myfolder/mydata.data", outFile = "txn_dtl", overwrite = TRUE, rowsPerRead = 5, numRows = 5, type = "text", reportProgress = 2, stringsAsFactors = T) 
  
  I know type = "text" makes things a bit slow but I am using it because one of the string columns has some data values with commas in them. However, this takes forever and does not show any progress although reportProgress is set to 2.
  Please suggest what I should do to

1) Complete the loading of this small subset
2) View progress
3) Make the loading of the original file faster

Thanks
          Bibudh
